title: Thinking in modules
description: The author discusses challenges with inheriting code from other developers and proposes a modular approach to sharing frontend code.
body_html:
By Mads Stoumann

I think, inheriting code from other developers, can be a struggle. There, I said it!
That's because not two developers think alike — everyone has his or hers way of doing things.

Having said that, here's my personal take on how to tackle code-share between (front-end-) developers:

Think in modules.

No matter what you create on a site, being it an article, an accordion-, spot- or a video-block, think of it as an individual module, with it's own version number and "module-like" structure.

Happy coding!
